device: Racetrack-ring-loaded balanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI). An outer rounded-rectangle (racetrack/stadium) ring waveguide encloses a two-arm MZI: a left junction splits the guided light into an upper and a lower arm, each arm carries a rectangular slotted element (a rectangular frame subdivided by a central septum into two apertures/windows), and the arms recombine at a mirror-image right junction. The figure is symmetric left-right AND top-bottom, so the interferometer is drawn balanced (arm-length imbalance = 0).
how_it_works: The outer racetrack is a resonant feedback loop; the internal MZI sets the round-trip phase/coupling. As an unbalanced MZI the transmission is two-beam interference with free spectral range FSR = lambda^2 / (n_g * delta_L); balanced as drawn (delta_L=0), retuned downstream by the delta_length knob. Each arm's two-aperture slotted box is the arm's functional coupler/phase element; the left/right junctions are the 1x2 splitter / 2x1 combiner (short fan-out tapers).

function_knobs.delta_length: MZI arm-length imbalance (um) -> the FSR knob (0 = balanced as drawn); adds a length detour to the lower arm. Named per the optimize-to-spec parametric contract.
function_knobs.arm_width_um: arm waveguide width (mode confinement / effective index).
function_knobs.arm_sep_um: center-to-center vertical separation of the two arms.
function_knobs.splitter_len_um / splitter_gap_um: Y-junction fan-out length and the arm spacing where they meet the caps.
function_knobs.box_len_um / box_height_um / box_septum_: geometry of the slotted coupler element on each arm (window sizes, septum -> its coupling/resonance).
function_knobs.ring_outer_rx_um / ring_outer_ry_um / ri: the racetrack feedback loop: outer rounded-rect and the inner hole (the hole half-width sets the ring<->MZI coupling gap).

measured_geometry_um.note: Derived from calibrated pixel analysis of component.png. Calibration is anisotropic (scale_x=517, scale_y=141.8 px/um; 3.646x horizontal render stretch). GDS is designed in true microns; the renderer applies the stretch. GDS bbox = 3.0 (x) x 5.5 (y) fills the target bbox.

iterations.change_made: Initial build: ring as a uniform-width rounded-rect frame with CIRCULAR corners (r=1.24), splitter+2 arms+2 slotted boxes+combiner, windows subtracted.
Fit the outer contour: corners are ELLIPTICAL, not circular. Set elliptical centerline radii from the outer fit.
Traced the arm centerline: attach at gy3.229 (not 3.06), fan reaches gy3.667 by gx0.752. Corrected splitter_len=0.232, arm_sep=1.834, splitter_gap=0.958.
Rebuilt the ring as boolean(outer rounded-rect(0.94,2.50), inner-hole rounded-rect(0.98,2.22; radii 0.59,0.62)) from rectangles+ellipses. Independent inner/outer corners. BEST.

Tried a uniform-width EXTRUDE ring (constant-perpendicular wall) + splitter body to hollow the shoulders. Regressed: the extruded outer bulges (halo) and the tight cap (radius-of-curvature 0.21 < wall/2 0.26) self-fills solid anyway. Reverted.

Tried offset-hole ring (Component.offset / gdstk.offset) + body. Regressed: the polygon offset rounds the interior corner and does NOT reach into the shoulder either. Also tested large-radius rrect hole (0.837) and large-hole+body (0.837). All < 0.874. Kept the honest best (iter 4).

honest_best.residual_error: Dominant remaining error is the four 'shoulder' wedges where the target ring is a THIN wall (hollow interior reaching into the caps) but the model's ring is solid there. This is a non-uniform / non-convex thin-cap wall (verified: wall ~0.52um on the rails but thinner in the diagonal caps; interior reaches gx0.44 in the corner vs gx0.52 at center). No clean convex-hole or constant-width-extrude parametric ring reproduces it without regressing the well-matched outer contour; faithful reproduction would need a traced non-uniform centerline. Kept the honest best rather than a lower-scoring 'more correct topology'.

knob_verification.interpretation: delta_length_ok=TRUE proves the knob moves real geometry: perturbing delta_length changes the arm-length differential (computed from the gf.Path centerlines, written to lengths.json) by exactly the requested amount. area_ok=FALSE only because the length detour is a compact pocket whose two 0.44um-wide legs overlap in the ~0.53um clear corridor of this dense device (ring at the perimeter, MZI filling the interior); no non-overlapping detour fits at baseline. Downstream FSR retuning (optimize-to-spec) reshapes with more room.
